question: Should a maintainer approve this protected TUI regression repair once the current-base merge result and pending checks are refreshed?
rationale: The patch and supplied terminal/Gateway proof are favorable, but the `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision rather than automated cleanup or merge routing.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, confirm remaining checks pass, then merge the focused Ctrl+D behavior repair.

options.title: Request narrower proof review
options.body: Ask the TUI owner to inspect the inherited editor contract and the PTY evidence before deciding whether to merge.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, confirm remaining checks pass, then merge the focused Ctrl+D behavior repair.
